news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation Q2 EPS $3.30 beats $2.89 consensus; raises FY26 EPS view to $12.50-$13.10
news_items.summary: Q2 FY26 adjusted EPS $3.30 vs $2.8851 consensus; revenue $2.24B vs ~$2.18B expected. Management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $12.50-$13.10 (midpoint $12.80) versus prior consensus ~$12.26.

news_items.headline: ROK stock surges 5.4% on May 6 after strong earnings beat
news_items.summary: ROK closed +5.37% at $459.35 on 2026-05-06 following the Q2 beat. Stock outpaced industrial sector gains and trades near 52-week highs.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation up 8.6% after raising 2026 guidance on strong Q2 results
news_items.summary: Demand cited as especially strong in warehouse automation, data centers, and semiconductors with double-digit growth. Updated FY26 outlook well ahead of analyst expectations signaled sustained demand momentum.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation analysts raise price targets following upbeat Q2 results
news_items.summary: Multiple sell-side analysts raised forecasts and price targets on ROK following the Q2 beat-and-raise.

news_items.headline: Insider sale: SVP Lifecycle Services sells 460 shares of ROK for ~$206,992
news_items.summary: Matthew W. Fordenwalt, SVP Lifecycle Services, sold 460 shares on 2026-05-05 for an estimated $206,992. Small relative size; reported same day as Q2 results.

news_items.headline: ROK moved up 10.72% on May 5
news_items.summary: ROK gained 10.72% on 2026-05-05 on the day of the Q2 earnings release.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Multiple analysts raised price targets on 2026-05-05 / 2026-05-06 following Q2 beat-and-raise (per Benzinga). Consensus remains Buy (19 buys / 2 holds / 0 sells per one source; 26-analyst panel shows 15 buy / 14 hold / 1 sell). Note: 12-month avg PT of $428.66 sits below the post-earnings price ~$459, suggesting targets may still be catching up.

earnings_context.notes: Q2 FY26 (reported 2026-05-05): EPS $3.30 vs $2.92 est, revenue $2.24B vs $2.18B est. Strength in warehouse automation, data centers, semiconductors. FY26 guide raised to $12.50-$13.10 (mid $12.80) vs prior consensus ~$12.26. Next print scheduled August 5, 2026.
